region.title: AWS Region
region.description: AWS region of the DynamoDB tables (e.g., us-east-1). Required unless a custom endpoint is set

access_key_id.title: Access Key ID
access_key_id.description: Optional AWS access key ID. If omitted, the AWS endpoint uses the default credential chain and a custom endpoint uses local test credentials

secret_access_key.title: Secret Access Key
secret_access_key.description: AWS secret access key, required when an access key ID is provided

session_token.title: Session Token
session_token.description: AWS session token for temporary credentials (optional, requires access key and secret key)

endpoint.title: Custom Endpoint
endpoint.description: Custom DynamoDB endpoint URL (e.g., http://localhost:8000 for DynamoDB Local)

table_pattern.title: Table Pattern
table_pattern.description: Regex pattern to filter which tables to replicate (optional, all tables when empty)

consistent_read.title: Consistent Read
consistent_read.description: Use strongly consistent item reads for discovery and full refresh. Incremental sync always uses strongly consistent reads

max_threads.title: Max Threads
max_threads.description: Number of parallel scan segments used per table

retry_count.title: Retry Count
retry_count.description: Number of retries for failed operations
